verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an enterprise AI agent platform, but the evidence pack never shows a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Sierra's core product. The SDK, Studio and compliance material all describe a vendor-run platform. The open-source tau-bench repository is a separate research benchmark, not the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
